{{Quote|Battles and invasions have been reported in more than a dozen systems. Imperial fleets are being forced to intervene in the Vexta Belt, Entralla, Dactruria, and Tovarskl.|A newscaster, during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>}}
The '''Entralla system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Velcar sector/Legends|Velcar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]].
